Hero_Desc_Belita:
The most dignified queen of the witches.
Not just among the witches, but considering Elias as a whole, she is the only entity deserving of the title "queen."
She is a role model for the leaders of Elias.
Album_Hobby_Belita: Secretly eating sweets in the snack warehouse.
Album_Belita1: The cold and composed Witch Queen, Belita effortlessly controls the witches, who are inherently competitive and eats betrayal for lunch, with a single frosty remark.
Album_Belita2: Belita oversees the Elias Forest, particularly its subterranean realm. She safeguards and manages the roots of the Yggdrasil. Her palace is also located near the roots.
Album_Belita3: Belita possesses innate magical gifts akin to the Sprite Queen, Erpin. Belita's demeanor and appearance may be in stark contrast to Erpin, but they somehow inexplicably share similar auras.
Album_Belita4: Not a chatterbox, Belita is quiet even during conversations, excusing herself from big groups, opting to leave alone. Perhaps she does this because these groups exhaust her, and it's unclear whether this is due to her lofty demeanor or difficulty getting along with others.
Album_Belita5: Secretly following Belita on one of her departures, I discovered her huddled alone, sobbing, in a hidden place. As I approached her, to see what was going on, I found she was merely enjoying snacks... tears of joy streaming down her face.
Album_Belita6: Her obsession with snacks is rather unusual. Her indiscriminate fixation with any type of snack, from the sprite-made confectioneries to the mass-produced junk food made by the elves. It's a bit of a turnoff.
Album_Belita7: According to what Belita told me later, she and Erpin are actually twin sisters. Right from their birth, they were assigned to govern Elias, with Erpin overseeing the surface and Belita ruling the underground. I was surprised to learn this, but this explains the subtle similarities between them.
LoveHero_Belita:
If it's about protecting
Yggdrasil,
I will help.
LoveHeroCancel_Belita:
Not asking about the
location of the secret snack warehouse?
Not so greedy aren't ya.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Hate1: As soon as she saw the dish, Belita slammed her fists, shattering the plate.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Hate2: After cutting the cutlet, and seeing the empty space inside it, Belita stared at me with suspicious and disbelieving eyes all day.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like1: After quickly scrutinizing the other witches around her, Belita ran inside the food warehouse, ate a quick meal, then came right back out.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like2: Belita quickly devoured this piece of cake, then immediately ordered the rest.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like3: Belita looked at this food with awe, saying it was food that could satisfy both sprites and witches.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like4: Happy there's a new snack, she expresses her concern for the impossibility of 'consuming it elegantly,' since its tempting flavor encourages eating several pieces at once.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like5: Belita thought it made for a tantalizing snack. With a pitiful face, she wondered if it could be delivered to the witches' community.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like6: Belita liked that it matched the color of underground food, so she didn't need to be wary of her subjects' glances.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like7: Belita was fascinated by the unusual combination of ingredients, considering how hard it is to find them in Elias. She seemed to really enjoy the taste.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like8: Belita praised the artistic sweet taste followed by a bitter aftertaste. Her expression brightened. Apparently, it's been a while since she had something sweet.
Food_ChefNote_Belita_Like9: Belita said because the candy pleases all tastes among the Elias race, the candies receive a high praise as extraordinary food.

Belita_Affinity1_2: The true form of Yggdrasil lies in its roots.
Belita_Affinity2: What a great idea. But what did you say?
Belita_Affinity1_3: No need to be intimidated just because I'm a Queen. Just relax.
Belita_Affinity3: Sprites and witches are alike... They don't listen to their Queen.

Belita_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Hmph... You won't get away with this!

Belita_Growth2_Skin3: Good. I can depart at any time.
Belita_LevelUp_Skin3: A queen's path is not deterred by the weather.
Belita_Equipment_Skin3: I must dress appropriately for my station.

Belita_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: I feel as though I could withstand any cold.

Belita_Touch1_Skin3: W-why would you do that so suddenly?
Belita_Touch1_1_Skin3: Take care. You will wipe off my makeup!
Belita_Touch1_2_Skin3: Ngh, what a truly spiteful prank.
Belita_Touch2_Skin3: Well? Does my new hairstyle suit me?

Belita_Touch2_2_Skin3: Take your time. We have plenty of it.
Belita_AsideGet: I'll always think of you, my dear sister.

Belita_Line3: I wonder whether my younger sister is doing well.
Belita_Lobby: There are many subordinates around me.
LoveLetter_Belita: Master, thank you for always being there for Erpin. She's upright and kind-hearted, but her gentle nature has always been a concern for me. Knowing that Ner and you are by her side brings me comfort.I'll admit, I sometimes find myself envious of Erpin. As the Witch Queen, I rely on Fricle's support, but as Belita the Witch, I often find myself feeling lonely.Please don't feel pressured, but a visit to the underground now and then would bring me happiness. I'll end this here, as you must have a lot on your plate.
LoveCall_Belita:
Ah, Master. It is I, Belita.
I feel that I have become quite accustomed to using a smartphone. Even from so far away, we can hear each other's voices and ask how the other is doing. It still feels wondrous when I stop to consider it.

So, what were you doing? Have you eaten properly?
Good. I am relieved that you seem well.
My days remain the same as always. I attend to official duties, think of Erpin, have a snack, then worry about Erpin again...
And then I thought of you, Master.
Before I realized it, your presence had become a natural part of my everyday life.
Thank you, always, Master.

Whenever you think of me, you may call at any time. If the call is from you, I shall set aside even the most pressing matter to answer.
Affinity_Belita_EP01_001:
Sometimes, it's burdensome to have my subjects constantly follow me.
There are times when I desire solitude in silence.
Affinity_Belita_EP01_002: Why not just order them to leave?
Affinity_Belita_EP01_003:
A queen's subjects must always be at her side to advise,
so they often ignore such orders.
Affinity_Belita_EP01_005: Run away? You want me to abandon my throne and kingdom and run away? What an irresponsible thing to say...!
Affinity_Belita_EP01_006: How about setting a schedule for your subjects?
Affinity_Belita_EP01_007:
A kingdom never sleeps, but everybody needs to rest, so... that should be okay...?
I'll keep your advice in mind.
Affinity_Belita_EP02_001: I was a little worried, but Yggdrasil seems to be well-managed at the surface. I'm proud of my little sister.
Affinity_Belita_EP02_002: Don't thank her, thank the subjects around her.
Affinity_Belita_EP02_003: What do you mean? Are you saying the Sprite Queen dumps all her work on her subjects?
Affinity_Belita_EP02_004: Well... the Sprite Queen does try her best... in a way... kind of.
Affinity_Belita_EP02_005: As long as we keep this up, Yggdrasil will grow big and tall. I'm glad.
Affinity_Belita_EP02_006: Ask her if she can detain her sister and get her to fix the way she thinks.
Affinity_Belita_EP02_007: You want me to do what to my sister...? Master, how can you say such things about your queen?!
Affinity_Belita_EP03_001: What are your thoughts on how to distinguish between flattery and sincere counsel from your subjects?
Affinity_Belita_EP03_002: Since the judgment is yours to make, you must conduct a thorough examination.
Affinity_Belita_EP03_003:
A textbook answer isn't always the right one.
Unless you're a divine being, you can't possibly examine every nook and cranny of your kingdom.
Affinity_Belita_EP03_004: You should first fill your palace with subjects you can trust.
Affinity_Belita_EP03_005: Indeed, figuring out the capabilities of your subjects comes first. That's also the difficult part, though.
Affinity_Belita_EP03_006: Instill a climate of fear with severe consequences for when things go wrong.
Affinity_Belita_EP03_007:
That's not something I would recommend.
It might work temporarily, but it's not really effective in the long term.
Affinity_Belita_EP04_001: Do you mind if I take, uh... that thing I secretly ordered... again?
Affinity_Belita_EP04_002: Your secret order? You mean the box of dark chocolate with honey syrup?
Affinity_Belita_EP04_003: Shush! Put that in my magic pouch before my subjects hear about it! Thank you, as always.
Affinity_Belita_EP04_004: A secret order? You mean the frozen cilantro veggie meatball?
Affinity_Belita_EP04_005: I... I never ordered something like that... Did you even pay attention to my order?
Affinity_Belita_EP04_006: A secret order? You mean the life-size cut-out of Yggdrasil?
Affinity_Belita_EP04_007:
Wh-What? You sell stuff like that? Where do you get such a large sheet of paper?
This is an unexpected score.
Affinity_Belita_EP05_001: Why do we get such few tourists to the underground? Our scenery is just as spectacular as the surface...
Affinity_Belita_EP05_002: That's because the inhabitants are always fighting each other, be it witches or dragons.
Affinity_Belita_EP05_003: But... we don't fight tourists, do we? Wouldn't the fights be just another great attraction for them?
Affinity_Belita_EP05_004: It's dark, damp, and stuffy there... need I say more?
Affinity_Belita_EP05_005: I see. There are times when I miss the blue sky sometimes, too.
Affinity_Belita_EP05_006: Should I have the Order rent a bus and go on a group tour?
Affinity_Belita_EP05_007: A bus...? I don't know what that is, but if you come, I'll welcome you in person!
Affinity_Belita_EP06_001: Sometimes I wonder if our looking after Yggdrasil is a good thing.
Affinity_Belita_EP06_002: Why? Are you afraid that you might be spoiling it rotten?
Affinity_Belita_EP06_003: Master! You shouldn't say it like that! You aren't completely wrong, though...
Affinity_Belita_EP06_004: Are you saying that nature should be left to nature?
Affinity_Belita_EP06_005:
That's right.
I just have a feeling that it will grow well on its own even if we don't do anything to it.
Affinity_Belita_EP06_006: You should continue looking after it. You said it's your calling in life.
Affinity_Belita_EP06_007:
Right...? It is in our instincts to care for Yggdrasil...
Thank you for listening to my concerns.
Affinity_Belita_EP07_001: The way the Order "prays"... Is that actually okay?
Affinity_Belita_EP07_002: Ah... you mean where everyone prays by napping?
Affinity_Belita_EP07_003: Y-Yes! Is napping really all you have to do? It bewilders me every time!
Affinity_Belita_EP07_004: The Head Priestess says it's okay, so it's probably okay. Just enjoy your nap.
Affinity_Belita_EP07_005:
But if you sleep at night, do you actually need to pray?
I mean, it's nice to rest more, but still...
Affinity_Belita_EP07_006: There's a priestess who has been praying for five years.
Affinity_Belita_EP07_007: She's been sleeping for five years...? Shouldn't you wake her up?
Affinity_Belita_EP08_001:
Master, has Yggdrasil ever spoken to you?
I'm asking if you've ever received a revelation or anything like that.
Affinity_Belita_EP08_003: Hmm, really? So even the Master cannot communicate with Yggdrasil directly...?
Affinity_Belita_EP08_004: Well, I'm not sure. Could a ridiculous dream be considered a revelation?
Affinity_Belita_EP08_005: Why, what kind of dream did you have? Why don't you try keeping a dream diary?
Affinity_Belita_EP08_006: I hear that I am the rightful ruler of Elias.
Affinity_Belita_EP08_007: ...I see... Uh, sure, okay. You have a strange sense of humor, Master.
Affinity_Belita_EP09_001: Yesterday, I spent the whole day mediating witches who were fighting, and now I'm tired.
Affinity_Belita_EP09_002: Give them a noogie each time they fight.
Affinity_Belita_EP09_003: Their heads would be completely misshapen if I did that. The bumps would keep growing until they became horns.
Affinity_Belita_EP09_005: Sigh... Does that even matter, Master...? Are you even listening to me?
Affinity_Belita_EP09_006: You've had it rough there. Would you like a warm cup of tea?
Affinity_Belita_EP09_007: Thank you. Mmm... this brief respite warms my heart.
Affinity_Belita_EP10_001: I would like to send a gift of friendship to Sprite Kingdom. What would you recommend?
Affinity_Belita_EP10_003:
That's probably best, right?
Maybe I should send arrowroot soup topped with mugwort syrup for old-time's sake, haha.
Affinity_Belita_EP10_005: Merch...? I have things like paintings of Yggdrasil's roots, but would that really be enough?
Affinity_Belita_EP10_006: Don't bother, you'll just spoil them.
Affinity_Belita_EP10_007: I'm sending it to ease tensions between us, so wouldn't it be a nice gesture? You've much to learn about diplomacy, Master.
Affinity_Belita_EP11_001: What do you think makes the Witch Kingdom worth visiting? I'm thinking of turning it into a tourist spot.
Affinity_Belita_EP11_003: I'm a bit reluctant to let tourists get too close... but I like how you see it as the symbol of our kingdom.
Affinity_Belita_EP11_004: The lights in the town square.
Affinity_Belita_EP11_005: Yes, that is one of our nice attractions. Though a witch once caused a commotion after blowing them up.
Affinity_Belita_EP11_007: Maybe I need to set up a stage and get a referee for them? Personally, I find them a nuisance.
Affinity_Belita_EP12_001: What counts as a proper witch's snack anyway? Fricle gave me an earful about it again today.
Affinity_Belita_EP12_003: *Sigh*... Yeah, that's a steady seller in the Witch Kingdom. Never really hit the spot for me, though.
Affinity_Belita_EP12_004: Has to be deep, dark chocolate.
Affinity_Belita_EP12_005: Not all witches have a taste for dark things. Hmm... Still, I'd happily take some dark chocolate if you're offering.
Affinity_Belita_EP12_007: Oh, I never asked that. Matching her taste might keep her from nagging me. Thank you.
Affinity_Belita_EP13_001: Isn't it strange? Why doesn't anyone think that Erpin could be the older sister? I mean, I am the older sister, but still...
Affinity_Belita_EP13_003: Why? Erpin can totally be dependable... What's with that look?
Affinity_Belita_EP13_005: Hmm. I can't deny that I'm a bit more mature. But I do treasure Erpin's innocence, too.
Affinity_Belita_EP13_006: Erpin should have that cute younger-sister charm.
Affinity_Belita_EP13_007: You see it that way, too, Master? I knew I wouldn't be the only one to see how cute she is. That's reassuring.
Affinity_Belita_EP14_001: It's only natural for the wisest to lead. That's how it is for all races.
Affinity_Belita_EP14_003: I think my sister has plenty of wisdom. Understanding when to push things and when to pull back is an important attribute of a ruler.
Affinity_Belita_EP14_005: Sylla commands the elementals with her bravery. She can be demanding, but that's also what keeps them in line.
Affinity_Belita_EP14_007: Shaydi uses her influence to dominate her underlings. Her authority is second to none.
Affinity_Belita_EP15_001: I get anxious whenever the elves get close to Yggdrasil's roots. I wonder why...
Affinity_Belita_EP15_002: Do witches and elves have bad blood with each other?
Affinity_Belita_EP15_003: There's a lot of strange back-and-forth between my witches and the elves. Since elves also live in Elias, I'm trying to be accepting of them.
Affinity_Belita_EP15_004: It's because you're overly suspicious of everything.
Affinity_Belita_EP15_005: Me? Possibly. Witches can be ridiculously crafty at times.
Affinity_Belita_EP15_006: Keep a close eye on them. They're definitely going to pull something weird.
Affinity_Belita_EP15_007: We can't just live in doubt forever, can we? Of course, it's always good to prevent disasters before they happen, though.
Affinity_Belita_EP16_001: What do the witches like? I'd like to know what my subjects usually like to order.
Affinity_Belita_EP16_003: Living underground does tend to make your food preferences a bit conservative. Still, it seems like they're eating healthy.
Affinity_Belita_EP16_004: They like bold and adventurous food.
Affinity_Belita_EP16_005: Looks like you've spent too much time in Sprite Kingdom. Now you're calling anything "not sweet" "bold and adventurous." I worry about you, Master.
Affinity_Belita_EP16_006: We're gonna need some more potatoes and sweet potatoes over here!
Affinity_Belita_EP16_007: Really? I can't believe there are witches like that... Why go through the trouble of coming all this way to have what they have every day?
Affinity_Belita_EP17_001: From your perspective, what do you think is the biggest difference between witches and sprites, Master?
Affinity_Belita_EP17_002: Whether they have horns or wings?
Affinity_Belita_EP17_003: Ah, so our appearances are what stood out to you. Well, we do look pretty different, I'll give you that.
Affinity_Belita_EP17_004: You guys have completely different diets.
Affinity_Belita_EP17_005: Ah, so that's what stands out to you here in the Banquet Hall. At least no one's going to be stealing each other's food.
Affinity_Belita_EP17_006: You're all cut from the same cloth... always causing chaos.
Affinity_Belita_EP17_007: Er... um... I suppose it's hard to stand up for anyone here... Please accept my apologies on behalf of my subjects.
Affinity_Belita_EP18_001: How's life in Elias? Any thoughts about coming to live underground?
Affinity_Belita_EP18_002: Got something good for me down there if I do?
Affinity_Belita_EP18_003: Nothing in particular, but your diet would be healthier. How do you feel about root veggies?
Affinity_Belita_EP18_005: Sunlight and warm air are precious. I respect your decision.
Affinity_Belita_EP18_006: You'll need to take a number. I'm making my rounds in order.
Affinity_Belita_EP18_007: Wait, you're going to go through all seven nations in order? What? Are you doing a boss rush or something?
Affinity_Belita_EP19_001: I'm at a total loss trying to figure out how to get witches to cooperate.
Affinity_Belita_EP19_002: Just band together when it really matters.
Affinity_Belita_EP19_003: When everyone has to band together, it usually means something's gone terribly wrong... do we really want things to get that bad? I'm not so sure.
Affinity_Belita_EP19_004: Try setting a goal you guys can all get behind.
Affinity_Belita_EP19_005: We do share one goal... caring for Yggdrasil. It's a relief that no witch is working against that.
Affinity_Belita_EP19_006: Even when you band together, factions still form within.
Affinity_Belita_EP19_007: That's also true. In the end, every witch for herself might just be the answer.
Affinity_Belita_EP20_001: Do you know what my subjects wish for? Care to share some of it with me?
Affinity_Belita_EP20_003: It'll take more than brute strength to beat me. Velvet needs to develop her abilities further.
Affinity_Belita_EP20_005: Whenever that kid has a day off, she finds a part-time job to fill it. There's not much I can do...
Affinity_Belita_EP20_006: Posher wants you to buy her potions.
Affinity_Belita_EP20_007: I was planning on inspecting Posher's store soon. Might as well pick up a bottle while I'm there.
